name: DirectChat – Floating Chat Button
author: Nitish Verma

sections.description:
WATCH: How to Setup DirectChat in 2 Minutes 👇

[https://youtu.be/R0aIiAfFg_4]

DirectChat allows your website visitors to contact you via WhatsApp instantly with a single click. Unlike other plugins, DirectChat features a modern Glassmorphism UI, smooth pulse animations, and is incredibly lightweight (No jQuery).

Whether you are a blogger, a business owner, or running a WooCommerce store, DirectChat helps you convert visitors into customers by bridging the communication gap.

🚀 Key Features (Free)

  • Click-to-Chat: Open WhatsApp app (Mobile) or WhatsApp Web (Desktop) automatically.
  • Modern Design: Beautiful floating button with glassmorphism effect.
  • Customization: Position the button (Left/Right) and change the Call-to-Action text.
  • Device Control: Show on All Devices, Mobile Only, or Desktop Only.
  • Pre-filled Message: Set a default starting message for users.
  • Lightweight: Zero impact on website speed (Written in pure JavaScript).

🔥 Upgrade to DirectChat Pro

Unlock the full power of WhatsApp marketing with the Pro Version. Designed for businesses who want to sell more.

👉 Get DirectChat Pro Now

✅ Multi-Agent Support
Add up to 3 agents (e.g., Sales, Support, Billing). Let customers choose who they want to talk to.

✅ Premium ChatBox Interface
Instead of redirecting immediately, show a professional Chat Window (Fake Chat UI) to engage users before they leave your site.

✅ WooCommerce Integration
Add an “Order on WhatsApp” button to your product pages. It automatically grabs the Product Name so you know exactly what the customer wants to buy.

✅ Analytics & Tracking
Automatically track clicks in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to measure your success.

✅ GDPR Compliance
Stay legal with a built-in user consent checkbox.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the directchat-floating-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘DirectChat’ in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp phone number with country code (e.g., 919876543210).
  5. Customize other settings as needed.
sections.faq:
How do I add my phone number?

Go to DirectChat settings in your WordPress admin panel and enter your phone number with country code (without + symbol). For example: 919876543210.

Does it support WooCommerce?

The Free version works on WooCommerce pages, but the Pro Version adds a dedicated “Order on WhatsApp” button specifically for products.

Can I add multiple numbers?

Multi-agent support is available in the Pro Version.
